title: Orari e appuntamenti
summary: Use simple structures for proposing, confirming and changing times.
contentNotice: Demonstration learning content for interface validation. It is not final MOSCATELLI policy, curriculum or language instruction and must be reviewed before operational use.

items: Va bene per le quattro? — Is four o’clock okay?
Possiamo spostare l’appuntamento? — Can we move the appointment?
Confermo per venerdì alle dieci. — I confirm for Friday at ten.

blocks.text: For operational coordination, repeat the day and time in the confirmation rather than relying on context. This reduces misunderstandings while the learner is still building confidence.
